test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

JOCK : GLZH :: HURT : EROQ :: SPIN : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**JOCK : GLZH**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65b6f98a643a9b1e6881759fd16af3da4bb7619c702c8bf86702457d40b8630e.png] 

**HURT : EROQ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/517f74d2e0df766a3bf3f4945379a754bb26c38b75b9d5c2d939cf9f5c56039e.png] 

Similarly,

**SPIN : ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cef45234a00a17a479536b0656f75da4c127facf6201847f0369855ae7f3b7c2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"PMFK"**.
